2.t: Those who take full measure ˹when they buy˺ from people

3.t: but give less when they measure or weigh for buyers

4.t: Do such people not think that they will be resurrected

6.t: the Day ˹all˺ people will stand before the Lord of all worlds

7.t: But no! The wicked are certainly bound for Sijjîn ˹in the depths of Hell˺—
7.tr: Kallaaa inna kitaabal fujjaari lafee Sijjeen

8.t: and what will make you realize what Sijjîn is?—

10.t: Woe on that Day to the deniers—

12.t: None would deny it except every evildoing transgressor
12.tr: Wa-maa yukazzibu biheee illaa kullu mu'tadin aseem

13.t: Whenever Our revelations are recited to them, they say, “Ancient fables!”
13.tr: Izaa tutlaa 'alaihi aayaatunaa qaala asaateerul awwaleen

14.t: But no! In fact, their hearts have been stained by all ˹the evil˺ they used to commit
14.tr: Kallaa bal raana 'alaa quloobihim maa kaanoo yaksiboon

15.t: Undoubtedly, they will be sealed off from their Lord on that Day

16.t: Moreover, they will surely burn in Hell

17.t: and then be told, “This is what you used to deny.”
17.tr: Summa yuqaalu haazal lazee kuntum bihee tukazziboon

18.t: But no! The virtuous are certainly bound for ’Illiyûn ˹in elevated Gardens˺—
18.tr: Kallaaa inna kitaabal abraari lafee'il liyyeen

19.t: and what will make you realize what ’Illiyûn is?—

22.t: Surely the virtuous will be in bliss

24.t: You will recognize on their faces the glow of delight

25.t: They will be given a drink of sealed, pure wine

26.t: whose last sip will smell like musk. So let whoever aspires to this strive ˹diligently˺
26.tr: Khitaamuhoo misk; Wa-fee zaalika falyatanaafasil Mutanaafisoon

27.t: And this drink’s flavour will come from Tasnîm—

28.t: a spring from which those nearest ˹to Allah˺ will drink

29.t: Indeed, the wicked used to laugh at the believers
29.tr: Innal lazeena ajramoo kaanoo minal lazeena aamanoo yadhakoon

30.t: wink to one another whenever they passed by

31.t: and muse ˹over these exploits˺ upon returning to their own people
31.tr: Wa-izan qalabooo ilaaa ahlihimun qalaboo fakiheen

32.t: And when they saw the faithful, they would say, “These ˹people˺ are truly astray,”
32.tr: Wa-izaa ra-awhum qaalooo inna haaa'ulaaa'i ladaaal-loon

33.t: even though they were not sent as keepers over the believers

34.t: But on that Day the believers will be laughing at the disbelievers
34.tr: Fal-yawmal lazeena aamanoo minal kuffaari yadhakoon

35.t: as they sit on ˹canopied˺ couches, looking on

36.t: ˹The believers will be asked,˺ “Have the disbelievers ˹not˺ been paid back for what they used to do?”
36.tr: Hal suwwibal kuffaaru maa kaanoo yaf'aloon
